title:
Base type for single-tenant "engines" i.e. {@link Engine.Deprecated engines} that serve just a single tenant and tag.
This means that there will be a separate instance for each active tag, and caches will not be shared across tags.

Single-tenant engines are assumed to be dependent on the types for their tag. Thus they will be restarted when
their tag is provisioned.

All methods exposed must be member methods. The system will use the default instance mechanism to set up or
re-use an instance for the appropriate tag when one of those methods is called.

A class that defines an engine by mixing SingleTenantEngine must use an external runtime to implement all its
actions (Python or Node.js). This means that all the methods it defines must be implemented by either `@py` or
`@nodejs` and all by the same runtime.

Note that engines are *not singletons*. Not only will there be different instances per tag, there will also be an
instance on each server node in the cluster.

@see Engine.Deprecated
@see MultiTenantEngine
name: SingleTenantEngine
